article.headline: Memphis heads to Sacramento for conference showdown
article.description: Memphis Grizzlies (2-0, fifth in the Western Conference) vs. Sacramento Kings (0-2, 15th in the Western Conference)
article.title: Memphis heads to Sacramento for conference showdown
article.linkText: Memphis heads to Sacramento for conference showdown
article.story: Memphis Grizzlies (2-0, fifth in the Western Conference) vs. Sacramento Kings (0-2, 15th in the Western Conference) Sacramento, California; Sunday, 9 p.m. EDT BOTTOM LINE: Memphis travels to Sacramento for a Western Conference matchup. Sacramento finished 22-60 overall, 14-38 in Western Conference action and 15-26 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Kings averaged 111.0 points per game last season, 17.6 from the free-throw line and 30.9 from beyond the arc. Memphis finished 25-57 overall and 19-33 in Western Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Grizzlies shot 45.6% from the field and 35.3% from 3-point range last season. INJURIES: Kings: Ben Simmons: out for season (achilles), Dylan Cardwell: out (calf), Maxime Raynaud: out (knee). Grizzlies: Cedric Coward: day to day (wrist). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
